gloss: prayer for passing an exam; wish for exam success

definitions.gloss: prayer for passing an exam; wish for exam success
definitions.explanation: A prayer or wish offered at a shrine or temple to pass an entrance exam or certification test. Expressed through visiting shrines, buying good-luck charms, or writing on votive tablets.

examples.japanese: {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I received a good-luck charm for passing exams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: The day before the exam, I went to a shrine to pray for success.

examples.japanese: {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{志望校|しぼうこう}→志望校：18904_shiboukou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}いて→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{奉納|ほうのう}→奉納：12200_hounou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I wrote the name of the school I hoped to attend on a votive tablet for exam success and dedicated it.

notes:
Combines ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧ (passing, success) + ⟦{祈願|きがん}→祈願：13745_kigan⟧ (prayer, supplication). A very common ritual for Japanese students, especially those taking university entrance exams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧: good-luck charm for exam success
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧: to visit a shrine to pray for success
- {合格祈願|ごうかくきがん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧: votive tablet wishing for exam success

CULTURAL NOTE:
Shrines dedicated to Tenjin ({天神|てんじん}), the deified scholar {菅原道真|すがわらのみちざね}, are popular destinations for students seeking blessings before exams.
